1704-4493-5195-7694.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4493-5195-7694.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Multiversal Incursion, Krark, any additional copies of Krark, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color..
Resolve a Krark trigger, flipping a coin and returning the Multiversal Incursion card to your hand if you lose and copying it if you win.
If you copy Multiversal Incursion, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers again, causing you to repeat steps 3 to 4.
Repeat steps 5—6 for each Krark trigger.
If Multiversal Incursion is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Multiversal Incursion card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Irenicus's Vile Duplication, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Multiversal Incursion and Irenicus's Vile Duplication end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.
